t: On the north side of Parliament Square stands a life-size bronze statue of Jan Smuts, between the statues of Lord Palmerston and David Lloyd George. It was made by the sculptor Jacob Epstein, who was born in the United States, moved to Europe in 1902 and became a British subject in 1910. Smuts was a South African statesman, soldier and philosopher. He served as Prime Minister of the Union of South Africa from 1919 to 1924, and again from 1939 to 1948.
